That’s $100 lower than the new retail price that went into effect (alongside plenty of other Apple price hikes) in June . You can also grab the 256GB model for $749 (usually $849), and the version with a cellular antenna for $799 (usually $899). Apple iPad Air M4 Where to Buy: $749 $649 at Amazon (128GB, Wi-Fi) $749 $649 at Best Buy (128GB, Wi-Fi) $899 $799 at Amazon (128GB, LTE) We reviewed the M4 iPad Air when it released in March, and found a very similar experience to the previous generation, for better or worse. The upgraded internals give the system a performance boost and better connectivity, like Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6, but otherwise this update is short on notable or exciting features if you’ve used an iPad Air the past few years. Read our Apple iPad M4 Air review . Other deals to consider The Garmin InReach Mini 2 is discounted to $249.99 at a variety of retailers, including Amazon , REI , and directly from Garmin . This compact device uses a satellite connection, which requires a Garmin InReach subscription , to provide emergency services, location sharing, and even text messaging when paired with smart device. Best Buy has the Anker 140W 4-Port Laptop Charger on sale for $55.99, a $24 discount off the usual price. With three USB-C ports and a USB-A port mounted on its bottom to prevent sagging in your outlet with multiple devices plugged in, you can easily charge a weekend worth of devices. The built-in display lets you check your total power usage at a glance, or make sure you’re charging at the right power level. Amazon is selling the Marshall Stanmore III Bluetooth speaker for $199.99, half off the usual retail price and matching the lowest price to date.
